lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Hello, Commander.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: I'm a worker at the Repair Center.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Have you got a minute?
Sure.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Any chance I can ask a favor of you?
What do you have in mind?

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Do you know what the Repair Center is for?
It's a hospital for Nikkes.
Not really.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: That's correct.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Oh, really? I was sure you'd know...

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: It's a hospital specially dedicated to Nikkes, to be exact.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: We usually conduct those kind of things. Ya know, conduct repairs, and swap out parts.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Sometimes though, we send out parts that are used for human surgery.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Anyway, that's enough about the Repair Center.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Why don't I get down to business?

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Currently, we're in desperate need of some second-generation Nikke parts.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: A parts order for human surgery has just come in,

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: so we can't refuse it.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Well, it's not like we can afford to, at least not in our current situation.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: I'm afraid I can't divulge too much, what with security concerns and all,

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: but do you think you can help us out?
Sure, no problem.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Out of all the second-generation parts, we need some arm and leg parts equipped with pressure sensors at the moment.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: These second-generation sensors are much like human nerve tissue.
Why are Nikke parts found in hospitals on the surface?

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: In short, surgeries used to be held there as well.
What kind of surgeries?

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: For anyone who had lost an arm or leg,

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: we would use second-generation Nikke parts as a temporary replacement.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: They were the best option in terms of time and expenditure.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Although the hospital remains unused,

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: there should still be some parts lying around.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: I'd hope you can head up to the surface and bring back some of those parts equipped with pressure sensors.
Understood.
